typography.instructions: DO NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings. Maintain strict typography hierarchy. Use tracking-tight for all headings.

colors.instructions: Use true grey base surfaces (zinc) rather than pure black. No generic full-screen gradients. Provide stark contrast for all text. Never use pure transparent background in header. Text color on hover must be explicitly defined.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-zinc-800. Expose the grid skeleton in layouts where possible.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Rely on 1px borders instead of soft shadows for the 'Technical' look. Use subtle inner shadows for interactive elements.
visual_enhancers.effects: Subtle glow around primary metrics using a blurred div behind the text with the accent color at low opacity (e.g., bg-cyan-500/10 blur-xl).
visual_enhancers.radius: Minimal. Use rounded-sm or rounded-md maximum. Keep sharp, tactical edges.

components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow. Hover: border color brightens, slight lift (-translate-y-px). DO NOT overuse. Use pure divs or dense grid borders.
components.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-sm). High contrast. Primary action should use the vivid accent color. Must include focus rings. Always set hover text color explicitly.
components.tables: Dense. Use border-b on rows, no vertical lines unless inside a tight grid. Use alternating row colors very subtly if needed.
components.navigation: Sidebar or top nav with glassmorphism or solid dark background. Never pure transparent.

layouts.dashboard_grid: MODE B: High Density Grid. Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gap (gap-4 or gap-6). Use h-full on children.
layouts.spacing: Use generous padding inside containers (p-6 or p-8) before content. Use tight spacing between related data items.
layouts.alignment: Left-align data, paragraphs, and labels. Center align only in empty states or standalone heroes.

motion.interactions: Hover states on all clickable elements. Transitions must be specific (e.g., transition-colors duration-200, transition-transform duration-200). DO NOT use 'transition: all'.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for list items or grid cards. Keep it fast (0.2s - 0.3s) and professional.

accessibility.contrast: Strict adherence to minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text. Use text-zinc-300 on zinc-950 for body text.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements MUST have visible focus states (e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-cyan-500 focus:outline-none).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.

media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react for a dense, developer-tool look. Weight: 'regular' or 'duotone'.
media.images: Use the provided image URLs. Ensure all user avatars have proper fallback and alt text.

backgrounds.description: Abstract tech texture for login screen or hero background

3d_libraries.decision: Not strictly necessary for this dashboard. Focus on Recharts for data visualization.
3d_libraries.recommendation: Use Recharts for line charts (email volume) and bar charts (replies). Stick to clean, crisp 2D.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize Shadcn UI for dashboard elements but customize spacing and borders to match the 'Technical' archetype.
Ensure all `.js` files follow these design guidelines.
Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, links, and forms for automation testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use the defined typography and spacing strictly.
Never apply `transition: all`. Use specific transitions.
Never center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Use Phosphor icons. Install with `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react`.
